vocab.example: Can you be the note-taker for today's meeting?
vocab.example_vi: Bạn có thể làm người ghi chú cho cuộc họp hôm nay không?

vocab.example: I'll transcribe the main points as we go.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi sẽ ghi lại các ý chính khi chúng ta trao đổi.

vocab.example: Please make sure to record every key decision we make.
vocab.example_vi: Hãy chắc chắn ghi lại mọi quyết định quan trọng chúng ta đưa ra.

vocab.example: Should I distribute the notes after the meeting?
vocab.example_vi: Tôi có nên gửi ghi chú sau cuộc họp không?

vocab.example: I'll list any outstanding item we didn't finish discussing.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi sẽ liệt kê những việc còn tồn đọng chưa bàn xong.

vocab.example: Once you finalize the notes, send them to me first.
vocab.example_vi: Khi bạn hoàn thiện ghi chú, hãy gửi cho tôi trước.

vocab.example: I want to make sure everything is documented clearly.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi muốn đảm bảo mọi thứ được ghi lại rõ ràng.

vocab.example: I'll share the notes with everyone by end of day.
vocab.example_vi: Tôi sẽ chia sẻ ghi chú với mọi người trước cuối ngày.

lines.speaker: Duc (manager)
lines.text: Linh, can you be the note-taker for today's meeting?

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Sure, I'll transcribe the main points as we go.

lines.speaker: Duc (manager)
lines.text: Great. Please make sure to record every key decision we make.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Will do. Should I distribute the notes after the meeting?

lines.speaker: Duc (manager)
lines.text: Yes, please send them to the whole team by tomorrow.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: Okay. I'll also list any outstanding item we didn't finish discussing.

lines.speaker: Duc (manager)
lines.text: Good idea. Once you finalize the notes, send them to me first.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: No problem. I want to make sure everything is documented clearly.

lines.speaker: Duc (manager)
lines.text: That's important, especially for the budget decision we made today.

lines.speaker: Linh
lines.text: I'll share the notes with everyone by end of day.

questions.q: What is Linh's role in the meeting?
When should Linh distribute the notes?
What does Duc say is especially important to document?
